entries.title: Proverbs 11:1
segments: ¶A false balance is an abomination to Jehovah; but a just weight is his delight.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:2
segments: ¶[When] pride cometh, then cometh shame; but with the lowly is wisdom.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:3
segments: ¶The integrity of the upright guideth them; but the crookedness of the unfaithful destroyeth them.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:4
segments: ¶Wealth profiteth not in the day of wrath; but righteousness delivereth from death.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:5
segments: ¶The righteousness of the perfect maketh plain his way; but the wicked falleth by his own wickedness.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:6
segments: The righteousness of the upright delivereth them; but the treacherous are taken in their own craving.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:7
segments: ¶When a wicked man dieth, [his] expectation shall perish; and the hope of evil [men] perisheth.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:8
segments: ¶The righteous is delivered out of trouble, and the wicked cometh in his stead.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:9
segments: ¶With his mouth a hypocrite destroyeth his neighbour; but through knowledge are the righteous delivered.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:10
segments: ¶When it goeth well with the righteous, the city rejoiceth; and when the wicked perish, there is shouting.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:11
segments: By the blessing of the upright the city is exalted; but it is overthrown by the mouth of the wicked.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:12
segments: ¶He that despiseth his neighbour is void of heart; but a man of understanding holdeth his peace.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:13
segments: He that goeth about talebearing revealeth secrets; but he that is of a faithful spirit concealeth the matter.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:14
segments: ¶Where no advice is, the people fall; but in the multitude of counsellors there is safety.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:15
segments: ¶It goeth ill with him that is surety for another; but he that hateth suretyship is secure.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:16
segments: ¶A gracious woman retaineth honour; and the violent retain riches.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:17
segments: ¶The merciful man doeth good to his own soul; but the cruel troubleth his own flesh.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:18
segments: ¶The wicked worketh a deceitful work; but he that soweth righteousness hath a sure reward.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:19
segments: ¶As righteousness [tendeth] to life, so he that pursueth evil [doeth it] to his own death.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:20
segments: ¶The perverse in heart are abomination to Jehovah; but they that are perfect in [their] way are his delight.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:21
segments: ¶Hand for hand! an evil [man] shall not be held innocent; but the seed of the righteous shall be delivered.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:22
segments: ¶A fair woman who is without discretion, is [as] a gold ring in a swine's snout.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:23
segments: ¶The desire of the righteous is only good; the expectation of the wicked is wrath.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:24
segments: ¶There is that scattereth, and yet increaseth; and there is that withholdeth more than is right, but [it tendeth] only to want.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:25
segments: ¶The liberal soul shall be made fat, and he that watereth shall be watered also himself.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:26
segments: ¶He that withholdeth corn, the people curse him; but blessing shall be upon the head of him that selleth it.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:27
segments: ¶He that is earnest after good seeketh favour; but he that searcheth for mischief, it shall come upon him.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:28
segments: ¶He that trusteth in his riches shall fall; but the righteous shall flourish as a leaf.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:29
segments: ¶He that troubleth his own house shall inherit wind; and the fool shall be servant to the wise of heart.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:30
segments: ¶The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life; and the wise winneth souls.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:31
segments: ¶Behold, the righteous shall be requited on the earth: how much more the wicked and the sinner.
